purpose: Structured narrator identity and jarh-ta'dil evidence without collapsing independent scholarly statements.
rules: A narrator catalogue entry is not itself a scholarly judgement.
Every judgement remains attributed to its named critic and source.
Different critics' statements must remain separately retrievable.
Identity uncertainty must be preserved rather than guessed away.
A hadith grade and a narrator grade are different evidence types.
No final automatic narrator verdict is produced from keywords alone.
